**Account Executive, SMB (Remote)

**About TrackSights & Your Role

**Every day, thousands of used cars change hands between traders, dealer groups and leasing companies across Europe, and most of those decisions are still made on gut feeling, spreadsheets and phone calls. TrackSights changes that. We turn live market, VIN, government, proprietary and other data into instant, trusted answers on what a car is worth, where it sells fastest and what it will return, so B2B traders, sourcing departments and remarketing teams can price, source and sell with confidence. And with every user we welcome, we're steadily building a network of trusted professional B2B players across Europe's automotive trade, a network our product roadmap is designed to bring closer together.

We started in 2025 and are already used across Europe, backed by Maki.vc and Cox Automotive, one of the world's largest automotive services companies. The product works, users stay and renew, and the sales playbook is proven: the founders have closed every deal themselves. That's exactly the problem worth having. Inbound is arriving, we're welcoming new users from all over Europe, and the founders can't be the whole sales team anymore.

So we're building one. This is the moment where TrackSights goes from founder-led sales to a commercial organisation, and from a Nordic start to the trusted data and insights partner for the used-car trade across Europe. You'd be joining at the start of that, taking over outbound and helping turn traction into real growth.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Originate & own deals end-to-end: prospecting, demo, negotiation, close, handover to Customer Success

• Handle SME sales to traders, sourcing and remarketing teams across our ICP in Europe, with no single-country focus, but a strong ICP focus

• Book your own meetings through consistent outbound: phone, LinkedIn, email, sequences in HubSpot and other relevant channels

• Build and manage your own pipeline; your numbers are shared with the team weekly/monthly

• Work with the founders on messaging, ICP and how we sell, and help improve the playbook

• Work closely with our two commercial founders and our Director of Customer Success

**You – You’re a Good Match If

**You're a self-starter and entrepreneurial go-getter who's motivated by growing sales while getting your hands dirty and owning your targets. We're building an organisation of good, kind, smart and ambitious people, with low ego, high ambitions and a can-do attitude.

Relentlessly driven to close. High outbound activity and a constant push to move deals to signature. This is our number one criterion.

• Relentlessly driven on outbound. No one hands you leads here. You build your own pipeline from week one, because without the hard outbound work there are no deals to close.

• Hungry for growth. You want to help build a company with international ambitions, and to grow your own responsibility within TrackSights as you deliver.

• Either 2–4 years in B2B or SaaS sales where you generated your own pipeline (not relying on inbound or SDRs), or a strong network and experience in the automotive B2B field plus sales experience

• A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets

• Driven to originate your own meetings, not waiting for inbound or SDRs to book them for you

• Builder mindset: you've written your own messaging or sequences before, you test and improve how you sell, and you're comfortable when not everything is defined

• CRM discipline: HubSpot preferred; structured in follow-ups, notes and pipeline, and you use the data to improve

• High ownership and consistency: you don't wait for direction, and you do the work

• You’re ambitious and want your commercial responsibility within TrackSights to grow over time, and take on larger projects or lead a team

**Languages

**

• English (required) and preferably, but not necessarily, Danish: full professional proficiency or native

• Danish, German or Dutch: a strong plus

**Your first 90 days

**

• Days 1–30: learn and get in the game already. Get up to speed on the product, the industry, the ICPs and the sales playbook. Shadow the founders on customer calls and start contributing with outreach and building your own network, already from week one.

• Days 31–60: build pipeline. You’ve already got several meetings in the books and held several. Run your own outbound, book your own meetings, run calls and demos end to end, find your rhythm in HubSpot, and maybe close your first customer. This is ultimately how you learn.

• Days 61–90: own it. Own your pipeline from first touch to close. Your first customers start to close, and you start contributing to how we scale sales.

Clear expectations for activity and results are agreed in writing before you start, and reviewed together every week.

**Why join

**

• Join an amazing team full of good people

• Join a truly exciting growth and international journey together with ambitious people, where only you set the limits

• Real ownership and impact in a company that's building its commercial organisation now

• Work directly with founders who closed current customers and proved the playbook

• Shape how sales is done, rather than executing someone else's playbook

• Where it can go: larger accounts, new markets, strategic responsibility, and in time a leading role with people under you, if you’re up to it. An option, not a requirement

**Compensation And How We Work

**

• Competitive base salary and an uncapped, attractive commission structure, with real upside tied to performance

• Warrant programme, so it feels like your company too

• Fully remote, with the option of an office (to be agreed)

• Danish holiday standards, team offsites (the last one was in Croatia!) and other perks

• High ownership, low bureaucracy, and a strong focus on culture and team fit (we only hire good-hearted people)

**Interested?

**Send us your CV and a short voice note on why this role and TrackSights make sense for you.

We will consider applicants and hire on an ongoing basis, and conduct a structured 3–4-step interview process.

Do you want to work with product compliance in practice? Are you motivated by bringing structure to data and documentation, following up with the right stakeholders and making sure accurate information is available on time? Do you enjoy taking ownership of the details that turn compliance requirements into reliable day-to-day decisions?

At STARK Group, we continuously strengthen our product compliance processes, and we are therefore expanding our team.

Product compliance is part of the Sustainable Sourcing team in Group Sourcing. In this role, you will report to the Director of Sustainable Sourcing and join a small team with expertise in product compliance, EUDR, supplier due diligence and Scope 3 emissions.

Your Role

In this role, you will help turn product compliance requirements into reliable day-to-day practices. You will maintain documentation, collect and validate supplier information, support compliance workflows, and ensure that product data is complete, accurate and available when needed.

The role will initially focus on the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) and the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), with the scope evolving as regulatory requirements, systems and business needs develop.

For EUDR, you will support day-to-day due diligence verification, data collection and risk management, including ensuring that relevant suppliers and products are set up correctly in our digital tool.

You will also manage supplier and product data for other regulatory requirements, including information requests, disclosures and follow-up on non-conformities.

What You Bring

• Relevant educational background within business, supply chain, sustainability, regulatory affairs, or similar.

• Experience working with documentation management, data administration, supplier coordination, or compliance-related processes.

• Experience with product compliance, regulatory documentation, certifications or sustainability-related requirements, including EUDR or PPWR, is an advantage but not a requirement. Guidance and training will be provided by subject matter experts.

• Strong attention to detail, organisational and stakeholder management skills, and a systematic approach to handling large amounts of information.

• Motivation to work with digital systems and data management tools.

• Fluent in written and spoken English. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

Why join us?

Build practical product compliance expertise in an international organisation, working across a diverse portfolio of building materials, including leading brands and Own Brand products. You will collaborate with colleagues across business units and Group functions, suppliers and third-party certification organisations.

You will learn from experienced specialists in a collaborative environment while taking ownership of meaningful operational tasks from the start. As our product compliance activities develop, you can broaden your knowledge, improve processes and grow with the role.

The role can be based at the STARK Group Head Office in Frederiksberg or STARK Huset in Viby J.

Sounds like a match?

If you see yourself as part of STARK Group, we look forward to hearing from you. Please submit your CV and application via our recruitment system. We interview on an ongoing basis and will finalise the hiring process once we have found the right match.

If you have questions, please contact Rikke Gade Christensen, Director, Sustainable Sourcing, at rikke.christensen@starksourcing.com.

We are also hiring a Specialist for product compliance within Sustainable Sourcing. If this opportunity interests you, please take a look at the other role to see which best matches your skills and interests

STARK Group

STARK Group is present in 8 countries with more than 18,500 employees and 1,050 branches. We are owned by CVC and, through strong relationships with more than 15,000 suppliers, we combine Group scale with local presence to deliver value for our customers, suppliers and Business Units. Please see more: www.starkgroup.dk

**Your impact begins here

**As Training Partner, you will build the training setup for the future 25L organisation while it is still taking shape. You will identify training needs, partner with leaders and turn business challenges into practical learning that gets people ready for their roles. Your work will support onboarding and capability building as 25L moves towards the PV phase in early 2028 and running production.

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring a strong learning mindset and the ability to translate business needs into practical, impactful training.

• A relevant degree within learning science, psychology, human resources or similar – or experience from a production environment combined with a passion for learning.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience developing training and learning activities.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholders.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership and proactively drive improvements.

• A solid quality mindset and fluent English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience developing training in a structured or regulated environment.

**What You’ll Do

**You will act as an advisor and operational partner to the business, making sure training is effective, compliant and supports performance and continuous improvement.

• Identify training needs and build the future training structure for 25L, including finalising training need analyses (TNAs) with key stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted partner to leaders, showing how training can address business challenges and support onboarding and capability building.

• Design, develop, implement and evaluate training content with stakeholders across day-to-day operations and projects.

• Deliver training on training standards, including train-the-trainer, and help develop high-quality Training Outlines (TROLs) and Job Instructions (JIs).

• Support continuous improvement and systematic problem solving together with colleagues across the organisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the 25L Training team in Hillerød, Denmark, where training excellence and continuous improvement are at the core. It is a small team, so you will collaborate closely and support one another in your day-to-day work.

Your closest partners will be leaders, content responsibles and your training colleagues. Together, you will make sure onboarding is effective, capability grows and the training setup can support the business as 25L moves from project phase to running production. Right now, the main focus is finalising TNAs with key stakeholders and building the training setup for the future organisation.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work close to the business, where your expertise is valued and your ownership makes a visible difference. You will be trusted to take initiative and drive improvements, and supported by a team that helps each other perform. As part of a global healthcare company, you will have opportunities to learn and develop as 25L grows.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400, corresponding to the level of the position. Placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the training that prepares 25L for what comes next, apply for the Training Partner 25L role by 15 November2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Sr. Manager Steven B. Rødkær, SVVR@novonordisk.com.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Analyst in Capital Planning – Help Shape the Bank’s Financial Future
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process.

More specifically, you will:

• Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections

• Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams

• Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers

• Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs

• Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables

**About You

**

• Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English

• Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field

• Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals

Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects
jobs.description:
Would you like to help orchestrate the global launch of new products, representing our supply chain throughout the entire launch projects?

Join a global group of skilled supply chain professionals and follow new products from early development all the way to market – as your input will ensure that we deliver the best products to people with intimate healthcare needs.

“We play a key part in planning and executing successful launches – and we are a valued voice in the process, allowing us to set a clear direction,” explains Head of Supply Chain Launch, Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen.

Join Our Highly Experienced Launch Department

Together, we are 7 colleagues, responsible for supply chain activities related to bringing new and innovative products to market within Chronic Care and Wound Care products. A good part of our time, we spend working with our factories in Hungary, Costa Rica, and soon Portugal.

“As we are each dedicated to different projects, discussing what we’ve learned with each other is very important to us. And we’ll be there to make sure you get to ease into the position,” says Daniel.

Ensure that supply chain is covered in every project

As part of the Coloplast global supply chain, you will find yourself in the middle of a web of stakeholders working towards launching new Chronic Care and Wound Care products. Here, you will be dedicated to specific projects, acting as supply chain lead or subject matter expert, representing the voice of supply chain and making sure supply chain is on track for launch.

Specifically, you will be the subject matter expert from supply chain, staying up to date on project progression. Moreover, you will plan the launch and make sure that systems, manufacturing, stock levels, etc. are ready for launch. And when you meet a bump in the road, you will figure out solutions with the project team.

From early project development until post-launch, you will:

• Influence project decisions and direction early, to avoid supply chain risks

• Drive the supply chain plan with manufacturing sites, balancing project deliverables and commercial considerations to launch on time

• Produce launch scenarios in collaboration with other departments and ensure alignment with the rest of the organization

• Coordinate activities at our production sites and flag supply chain risks

• Make sure systems, such as planning, base data and distribution, are ready for launch

• Follow up on delivery performance of newly launched items after launch

Your work may take you traveling roughly 2 weeks per year, primarily to our factory in Hungary. However, you will have a say on how the trips are planned, so they will fit with the rest of your life.

Supply Chain Knowledge And Stakeholder Management Skills

In this role, you must be able to work cross-functionally, using your good stakeholder management skills to incorporate a wide range of input from across the business. Also, you can work with limited supervision in your projects, representing the voice of supply chain, making decisions, and setting a direction for your area.

Finally, we imagine that you:

• Have a degree in supply chain or engineering

• Have some experience, either within supply chain or logistics and a good conception of production processes

• Possibly have some experience working in projects, allowing you to consider both commercial and supply chain perspectives

• Are good at Excel and at adapting to new systems

• Are fluent in English

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Head of Supply Chain Launch,

Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen on DKDAAR@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

_Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

__Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

__Visit us on Coloplast.com.

__Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

What does it take to turn great science and technology into strong commercial execution? It takes people who understand the value, know how to communicate it, and have the confidence and skills to engage customers effectively. As our new Commercial Training Lead, you’ll play a key role in making that happen.

You’ll own and develop our approach to commercial training across our global sales organization, distributors, and strategic MS vendor partners. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Market Development, Applications, and R&D, you’ll translate expertise into scalable training that strengthens commercial capabilities and prepares our teams and partners for what’s next. From value selling and product training to certification and new product launches, you’ll have significant opportunity to shape the role and make an impact. The role is based at our HQ in Odense and will report directly to our Chief Commercial Officer,

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

What we do

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein-based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for precision medicine.

Key tasks and responsibilities

Training Strategy & Curriculum

• Own the global commercial training strategy, roadmap and curriculum.

• Build a scalable model combining live training, digital learning, coaching and certification.

• Establish a central repository and LMS for training content.

Distributor & MS Vendor Enablement

• Own onboarding, training and certification for distributors and strategic MS vendor teams.

• Equip partners with Evosep value proposition, differentiation and joint customer messaging.

• Partner with Distributor Leader and Market Development to close capability gaps.

Product, Application & NPI Enablement

• Translate product, technology and application knowledge into compelling commercial training.

• Own the NPI training workstream, ensuring sales readiness before launch.

• Partner with Product Development, R&D, Marketing and Application for consistent positioning.

Sales Capability

• Develop training in value selling, sales methodology, qualification and negotiation.

• Support Sales Leaders with coaching tools and capability development.

• Identify gaps through field feedback and commercial performance.

Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

• Measure training impact using commercial KPIs, win/loss insights and field feedback.

• Track success metrics: time-to-productivity, certification, adoption, funnel progression and sales performance.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive can-do attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team.

For this role, we also imagine you bring:

• A background in commercial training, sales enablement or sales/application roles in life science, instrumentation or proteomics.

• A track record of scaling training across direct and distributor/partner channels.

• Experience supporting product launches with Marketing, Product and R&D.

• The ability to turn complex technology into clear, customer-value-led training.

• Strong skills in value selling, coaching and certification design.

• Skilled with LMS and digital tools to measure training impact.

• Excellent communication skills in a global, multicultural setting.

• A structured hands-on builder mindset to both design and execute.

• The ability to influence sales teams and partners without formal authority.

• A curious and outcome-focused mindset.

What We Offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supportive colleagues with a can-do mentality and a strong belief in our ability to make a real difference through what we do.

• An innovative, open, and dynamic culture where we continuously learn, improve, and develop.

• The opportunity to join a rapidly growing life sciences company and contribute to solutions aimed at improving quality of life and patient care.

• A competitive benefits package and lunch arrangement.

• Flexible working hours and work-life balance.

• New, modern office facilities in Odense.

• And the list goes on. Learn more about us on Evosep Careers.

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

What Happens After I Send My Application?

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible. We will conduct interviews continuously and we reserve the right to close the job advert as soon as the position has been filled, so do not hesitate to send us an application. It is important to us that we respond to all candidates who have spent time sending us an application and you will always as a minimum receive an email with a response once the hiring process is over.

Job location:

Odense M

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

If you have any questions, please contact

Benneth Bratberg

Chief Commercial Officer

bb@evosep.com

jobs.occupation: Maersk Air Cargo seeks a CAMO Base Maintenance Planner and Techrep
jobs.description:
Opportunity

At Maersk Air Cargo, we’re proud to play an important role in Maersk’s ambition to deliver truly integrated global logistics. Our aviation operation brings together specialist expertise, teamwork and a strong commitment to safe and reliable operations. We are now looking for a CAMO Base Maintenance Planner & Technical Representative to join our team and contribute to the continued development and success of our air cargo operation.

**About the role

**This is a hands-on role combining detailed base maintenance planning with the opportunity to represent CAMO on site during scheduled maintenance inputs. You will take ownership of assigned base maintenance events, including C-Checks, coordinating the work scope, materials and technical requirements before acting as the key CAMO interface with the contracted Part-145 maintenance organisation during the maintenance input. It’s an opportunity to work across the complete base-maintenance lifecycle rather than focusing purely on planning.

Flexibility to travel extensively is essential, with approximately 40–60 travel days per year, typically in periods of 2–5 weeks at a time, depending on the base maintenance schedule. Travel requirements may increase as the fleet grows. This role would particularly suit an experienced aircraft maintenance technician looking to transition from a hands-on, shift-based environment into a CAMO/office-based position, while remaining closely connected to aircraft maintenance activities.

What you’ll be doing

**Base maintenance planning & preparation

**You will:

• Plan and prepare assigned base maintenance inputs and the associated work package.

• Ensure scheduled tasks, ADs, EOs, inspections, modifications and other approved requirements are included.

• Coordinate material, component, rotable and modification-kit availability with Logistics.

• Align technical scope, schedule and readiness with Engineering, MCC, Technical Records and the selected MRO.

• Support task-card, maintenance-programme and planning-system improvements, including lessons learned.

Technical representation & on-site coordination

During assigned maintenance inputs, you will

• Act as the on-site CAMO Technical Representative and primary interface with the MRO during assigned checks.

• Monitor progress, findings, quality indicators, man-hour development, material status and schedule risks; report status to CAMO.

• Coordinate technical queries, additional work and findings; approve only within delegated authority and escalate when required.

• Monitor that the agreed maintenance scope is completed and appropriately documented by the contracted Part-145 organisation.

• Coordinate return-to-operation readiness with iOCC and relevant stakeholders, including deferred-item disposition where applicable.

• Ensure maintenance records, release documentation and system updates are received, reviewed, filed and followed through to closure.

**What we’re looking for

**Ideally, you will have:

• A minimum of three years’ relevant continuing-airworthiness knowledge and practical experience.

• Good working knowledge of EASA Part-CAMO and Part-145, with knowledge of Part-21.

• Understanding of MSG-3 principles, Aircraft Maintenance Programmes and scheduled maintenance planning.

• Experience working with aircraft technical manuals such as AMM, IPC, SRM, SSM, FIM, WDM and MEL, as applicable.

• Good understanding of work packages, task cards, maintenance records, ADs, EOs, modifications and repairs.

• Relevant aircraft-type general familiarisation and applicable company procedures, including CTS-1 and CTS-2.

• Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder-management skills in English.

• The ability to work independently and make sound decisions within delegated authority.

• Flexibility to travel for extended periods during assigned maintenance inputs.

• Experience or an AML relating to Boeing 767 or Boeing 777 aircraft would be advantageous.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to combine your technical maintenance experience with planning, coordination and technical representation in an international air cargo environment, we’d like to hear from you. Apply today!

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

Our technical OT/ICS team is expanding, so we're looking for a senior technical consultant to join an ambitious cybersecurity team working with clients across the globe.

**What You'll Do

**You'll join a team of highly skilled engineers and consultants working at the intersection of IT, Operational Technology (OT), automation, and cybersecurity – with protecting and monitoring OT networks at the core of what we do.

**In This Role, You'll Own

**

• Advanced threat detection and engineering: working extensively with industry-leading technology providers to deploy, test, and tune advanced threat monitoring solutions in production environments

• Technical implementation: leading the design and implementation of OT network segmentation projects, architecture redesign, secure remote access integration, and asset/configuration analysis

• Consultancy and advisory: acting as trusted advisor to clients and colleagues on architecture reviews and OT risk assessments, and translating technical risk into business impact

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for a seasoned OT Cybersecurity Principal Consultant with extensive experience in infrastructure solutions and technology deployment in OT environments.

**The Ideal Candidate Comes With

**

• At least 5 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, including client-facing consulting roles

• Demonstrated capability across critical security domains such as network segmentation, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, secure remote access, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and Security Operations Centre enablement

• A track record of continuous technical development — for example, certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC, CCNA/CCNP, or product certifications with recognised OT security vendors such as Nozomi or Claroty

Clearance for SECRET (HEMMELIGT) with Danish authorities is a plus.

**What We Offer

**We're a growing and ambitious tech startup that puts technical excellence first. We invest in the tools, tradecraft, and certifications needed to stay at the forefront of our domains, and continuously sharpen our expertise.

You'll join a team of highly skilled specialists working on complex OT cybersecurity challenges, helping shape both our capabilities and the services we bring to market.

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

For any questions about the position, contact Anders Rømer at anrs@thetechcollective.eu.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Senior M365 Security Engineer to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Secure Infrastructure domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Senior M365 Security Engineer who wants to make a difference in our Secure Infrastructure domain.

Secure Infrastructure

Looking at the actual threat landscape today, it’s more important than ever to design and build infrastructure solutions that incorporate correct and relevant security features. The team works closely together using their combined knowledge and experience gathered from different projects and Incident Response cases to help our customers stay ahead of the threat actors. We continuously help customers improve their security posture within cloud, data center, endpoint management, identity, M365, and networking.

The Role

Truesec is looking for a Senior Microsoft 365 Security Engineer to our Secure Infrastructure team. The role interfaces regularly with team members and customers to determine technical requirements, feasibility of projects and expectations. You are responsible for maintaining, implementing, and designing client-facing solutions across Microsoft 365 Security and Azure.

This role is for someone who wants to be hands-on in a technical role across Cloud Security, Identity Security and Data Security. You will work with security configurations and policies within M365 and Entra ID, while also configuring and optimizing Microsoft Purview capabilities. You will help customers protect users, identities, devices and critical data across Microsoft 365 services including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints.

You will work closely with security specialists across Secure Infrastructure and have the opportunity to contribute to projects that combine M365 security, Purview and broader security initiatives.

Other responsibilities you might have can be:

• Run health and security checks within M365, Entra ID and Microsoft Purview

• Configure and optimize security and data protection policies across Microsoft 365 services

• Provide customers recommendations and prioritization of how to improve their security and data protection posture over time

• Implement solutions based on Statement of Work with customers

• Deliver training and workshops to clients and colleagues within M365 security best practices

Your Potential Background

We believe that your background probably entails 5+ years of experience and expertise within the Microsoft public cloud, such as M365 Security, Entra ID, Intune and Microsoft Purview, including troubleshooting, deploying and configuring of said solutions. It’s likely that you have worked with a combination of identity, cloud security and data security, including areas such as Conditional Access, Defender, Microsoft Information Protection, sensitivity labeling, encryption, rights management, data classification and Data Loss Prevention.

You are comfortable working hands-on with technical configurations while also being able to explain security concepts, risks and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills:

• Strong experience of the M365 Security platform

• Strong experience of Entra ID

• Ability to script and automate using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or related APIs

• Experience working with Microsoft security services such as Defender, Conditional Access or Intune

• Ability to prioritize and create implementation plans for customers

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfortable in conducting trainings and workshops to clients and colleagues within M365 security best practices

• Knowledge in Microsoft Purview

Bonus Skills:

• Experience within Client Management

• Understanding of M365 licensing, including licensing related to Microsoft Purview and Compliance features

• Experience with hybrid environments

• Experience with Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance, Audit, eDiscovery or retention policies in Microsoft Purview

• Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 or similar data protection regulations

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Hos Awaze hjälper vi människor att komma iväg på semester – och det kan vi bara göra tack vare våra engagerade husägare. Vi söker två nya kollegor som kanske studerar just nu och vill ha ett flexibelt extrajobb med möjlighet att arbeta både dag- och eftermiddagstid. Vi söker dig som talar flytande norska eller svenska samt danska och som vill vara med och bygga starka relationer, säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet och behålla våra husägares förtroende.

Ditt uppdrag

Som vår nya Customer Experience Specialist blir ditt uppdrag att säkerställa en professionell, förtroendefull och värdeskapande upplevelse för våra husägare genom hela deras resa med NOVASOL.

Du blir en del av ett ambitiöst och samarbetsinriktat team som brinner för att skapa goda relationer och leverera service av hög kvalitet. Oavsett om det handlar om att besvara förfrågningar, ge råd om intäkter eller introducera nya husägare får du en central roll i att säkerställa att våra husägare väljer att stanna hos oss – och trivs med det.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

• 
Vara den primära kontaktpersonen för husägare via telefon och e-post

• 
Hantera både enkla och komplexa förfrågningar – med fokus på att lösa ärenden redan vid första kontakten

• 
Bygga upp och vårda relationer med husägare och ge dem en positiv upplevelse hos NOVASOL

• 
Ge husägare råd om hur de kan optimera sitt semesterhus och sina intäkter

• 
Säkerställa korrekt rådgivning och hög kvalitet i all kommunikation

Profilen vi söker

Du kommer att trivas i den här rollen om du motiveras av att prata med människor, skapa relationer och hitta lösningar – även när uppgifterna är komplexa.

Vi söker en kollega som kan bidra med:

• 
Stark kommunikationsförmåga och en naturlig känsla för kundservice

• 
Förmåga att bygga förtroende och professionella relationer

• 
Ett nyfiket och lärande förhållningssätt – du vill ständigt utvecklas

• 
Ett problemlösande och positivt förhållningssätt där utmaningar ses som möjligheter

• 
Ett samarbetsinriktat och proaktivt sätt att få saker gjorda

Så lyckas du i rollen

• 
Säkerställer hög nöjdhet och lojalitet bland våra husägare

• 
Levererar professionell rådgivning som skapar värde för både husägare och verksamheten

• 
Bygger starka relationer som stärker förtroendet för NOVASOL och Awaze

• 
Bidrar aktivt till teamets prestationer och gemensamma kommersiella resultat

• 
Utvecklar dina kompetenser genom kontinuerligt lärande och erfarenhetsutbyte

• 
Talar flytande norska eller svenska och gärna danska

Därför vill du arbeta hos Awaze

Vi erbjuder en varierad tjänst i en stark professionell och social miljö som du får möjlighet att påverka. Du blir en del av ett internationellt företag som investerar i framtiden och arbetar målmedvetet med utveckling – både av verksamheten och våra medarbetare.

Du kan bland annat se fram emot:

• 
Attraktiva rabatter på semesterboenden för dig, din familj och dina vänner

• 
Grundlig introduktion och utbildning i våra produkter och system

• 
Goda möjligheter till professionell och personlig utveckling över olika roller och länder

• 
Att bli en del av en mångsidig och inkluderande arbetsmiljö

• 
Ett engagerat team med passionerade chefer och kollegor

• 
Lunchordning samt träningsmöjligheter på kontoret

Om Awaze

Vårt uppdrag är tydligt – att skapa fantastiska semesterupplevelser med Europas största utbud av semesterboenden.

Med mer än 110 000 boenden runt om i Europa är vi marknadsledande inom uthyrning av semesterhus. Vår ambition är inte bara att vara störst, utan att vara den mest uppskattade och bästa leverantören av semesterboenden i Europa.

Resebranschen är i ständig utveckling och vi fokuserar på att forma nästa kapitel. Vi stärker kontinuerligt relationerna med våra gäster och husägare, utvecklar vårt sätt att arbeta och levererar starka resultat. Genom att göra våra processer enklare och mer effektiva bygger vi en organisation som är rustad för framtiden – driven av stolta, passionerade och inkluderande medarbetare.

Bra att veta

• 
Arbetsplats: Contact Center i Skejby, Hedeager 44, 8200 Aarhus N

• 
Gratis parkering samt enkel tillgång till spårväg och buss

• 
Anställningen innebär att inget bestämt antal arbetstimmar garanteras, vilket också ger dig stor flexibilitet att planera din tid. Eftersom vi arbetar i en säsongsbetonad verksamhet där människor åker på semester året runt finns det alltid mycket att göra. Särskilt under vår högsäsong på sommaren finns det möjlighet att arbeta många pass.

Vad händer härnäst?

Om det här låter som rätt nästa steg för dig, klicka på ”Ansök” och följ instruktionerna för att skicka in din ansökan. Vi anpassar vår rekryteringsprocess efter varje enskild roll för att ge både dig och vårt rekryteringsteam de bästa förutsättningarna att bedöma om detta kan bli början på ett bra samarbete. Du hör från oss så snart vi har gått igenom din ansökan.

Vi är engagerade i att säkerställa en inkluderande och tillgänglig rekryteringsprocess. Alla ansökningar behandlas likvärdigt. Om du har särskilda behov eller önskemål inför intervjun är du varmt välkommen att informera oss när du tackar ja till inbjudan – vi gör gärna de anpassningar som behövs.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant – Social Media and Event Planning
jobs.description:
About us

At Danske Spil, we work with games, dreams and entertainment – and our profits go to sports and voluntary associations. In BDI, Business Development & Innovation, we develop new gaming products that go beyond the traditional. We test fast, learn and fail.

You will be exposed to the entire value chain: from idea to launch to sales optimization. Here, success is measured by what we bring to market – not by the number of ideas.

Your role

Working closely with the innovation team, you will help bring new gaming products to life on social media – from planning content to executing launches and keeping the momentum going afterwards. You will help shape and execute our social media strategy around new products.

What you will be doing

• 
Developing and executing social media campaigns for product launches and market tests

• 
Creating inspiring content (posts, stories, video ideas, graphics) for Instagram, TikTok and other relevant channels

• 
Supporting event planning and execution for product launches, from concept to hands-on delivery

• 
Analysing social media performance and keeping up with trends to bring fresh ideas for engagement

• 
Automating marketing tasks, plus various administrative tasks

Who are you?

You have more than a year left of your studies and experience with social media and events. You have a creative mind, you are curious by nature, and you are not afraid to ask questions along the way.

• 
You love social media and understand how to create engagement across different platforms

• 
You are creative and able to work in a structured way

• 
You are proactive and ask questions

• 
You are curious about working in a cross-functional team and about events, and see the potential in combining physical and digital activities

• 
You are interested in how AI can be used in marketing

Preferred fields of study

• 
Communication and Culture

• 
Digital Marketing or Business and Marketing

• 
Media and Information Studies

• 
Event Management or Branding and Strategic Communication

• 
Creative Technology / Digital Design

Practical details

The hourly wage is DKK 174 as a bachelor’s student and DKK 179 as a master’s student on weekdays. The expected working time is 12–16 hours per week. Your working hours are agreed with your closest manager, but we know that your studies come first, so we will of course take exam periods into account.

We read applications on an ongoing basis, but the deadline to apply is 26 November 2026. If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jesper Kildegaard, Head of Innovation, at JEKP@danskespil.dk. If you have questions about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact HR Business Partner Majbritt Storm Lindegaard at MASB@danskespil.dk.

Do you have experience developing medical devices or other regulated products? Are you skilled at translating clinical and business needs into clear priorities for technical teams? Would you like to help develop innovative AI solutions that can improve patients’ lives?

Then your next career move may be as Product Owner for AI Development at Ambu.

AI Development at Ambu

You will join the Algorithms department within Software & Electronics in Ambu’s global R&D organization. The department develops advanced AI and algorithmic solutions for Ambu’s endoscopy products and includes specialists in deep learning, image processing, and data engineering.

You will be Product Owner for a cross-functional Agile team consisting of AI developers, data engineers, and a Test & Verification engineer. The team participates in Ambu’s Scaled Agile Release Train, ART, and collaborates closely with other teams and stakeholders.

The position is based in either Ballerup, Denmark, or Augsburg, Germany. You will report to Lee Lassen, AI Manager, who is part of the Algorithms leadership organization under the Head of Algorithms.

Your Role

As Product Owner, you will maximize the value delivered by the AI development team. You will translate product objectives, clinical needs, technical opportunities, and regulatory requirements into a clear and prioritized backlog.

You will work closely with Product Management, engineering managers, architects, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, project stakeholders, and other Product Owners across the ART.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Own, prioritize, and maintain the team backlog in alignment with product priorities and ART objectives.

• Translate clinical, product, technical, quality, and regulatory needs into clear features, user stories, enablers, and acceptance criteria.

• Participate actively in PI Planning and support the definition and delivery of realistic, value-driven PI objectives.

• Coordinate priorities and dependencies with Product Management, architects, other Product Owners, Agile teams, and relevant stakeholders.

• Guide the cross-functional team through AI development activities spanning data preparation, model development, testing, verification, and product release.

• Monitor progress, risks, and dependencies while supporting design control, continuous improvement, and effective Agile ways of working.

Occasional travel between Ambu sites and other development locations should be expected for up to 20 days / year.

Suggested Candidate Profile

You are proactive, structured, and committed to delivering value. You enjoy working with technical specialists and can balance product, clinical, technical, regulatory, and business considerations.

You are likely to succeed in this position if you have:

• A relevant degree in engineering, computer science, data science, biomedical engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience as a Product Owner, technical Product Manager, project lead, or in a similar product-development role.

• Experience with medical devices or another regulated industry, including design control, requirements, risk management, and verification.

• Experience with Agile development and preferably working within a Scaled Agile Framework, SAFe, organization.

• A good understanding of AI, machine learning, data engineering, software development, or other data-driven product development.

• Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to create clarity across technical and cross-functional teams.

As Ambu is a global company, fluency in English is essential. All applications must be submitted in English.

How to Apply

We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so do not hesitate to apply.

For additional information about the position and Ambu, please contact:

**Lee Lassen

**AI Team Manager

Ambu A/S

leel@ambu.com

Your application will be treated confidentially.

Ambu: A Visionary and International Workplace Where Your Efforts Matter

Ambu is a rapidly growing company with ambitious goals. We achieve them through interdisciplinary collaboration between motivated and highly skilled employees.

By joining us, you will work in an international and collaborative environment where your contribution matters. We offer exciting professional challenges, strong development opportunities, and a broad range of professional, social, and financial employee benefits.

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to take ownership of our Identity & Access Management platform, encompassing Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Privileged Access Management, Identity Governance, and Identity Lifecycle Management.

This product is a critical strategic capability supporting all business units and serves as a foundational component of our Zero Trust security architecture. The role combines product leadership, stakeholder management, and deep understanding of modern identity platforms and security practices. As Product Owner, you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for identity services while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, architecture, and business objectives. You will work closely with Security Management, Architecture, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders across the organisation.

In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate closely across Poland and Denmark. We are open to candidates who would like to work either from our Warsaw office or from Roskilde, as for us, competencies and the right mindset matter more than location.

If you join us , you will report directly to Henrik Ellesø.

**Primary task and responsibilities include:

**

• Own the Identity & Access Management product strategy, vision, and roadmap

• Establish and maintain a prioritised product backlog aligned with business and security objectives

• Drive continuous improvement and modernization of identity governance and lifecycle management processes

• Lead stakeholder alignment across security, architecture, operations, and business functions.

• Develop and maintain a strong customer-focused network and trusted relationships to ensure IAM and Access Management solutions meet customer needs and deliver business value

• Define product KPIs, outcome measurements, and success criteria

• Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements including NIS2 and ISO 27001

• Drive future identity platform consolidation activities

• Foster a product mindset, focusing on business value, customer outcomes, risk reduction, and operational excellence

• Actively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and drive continuous improvement in alignment with the company's ways of working

The ideal candidate combines strong Identity & Access Management experience with the ability to translate business, security, and regulatory requirements into effective solutions. The candidate should be self-driven, able to take ownership and drive priorities independently, while ensuring continuous alignment with key stakeholders. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management, Identity Lifecycle Management, Zero Trust principles, and security compliance frameworks is essential.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Lead through influence rather than authority and have several years of experience operating in a Product Owner, Product Management, or Architecture role within complex organizations

• Bring experience from a area focused on Microsoft Entra ID, Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management, Identity Lifecycle Management, Zero Trust principles, and security compliance frameworks

• Bring strong Product Owner and leadership competencies:

• Have a proven track record of providing strategic direction and translating business objectives into a clear product vision and roadmap

• Have several years of experience building trusted relationships and influencing stakeholders across business and technology domains to create alignment and drive strategic outcomes

• Have several years of experience leading transformation initiatives and facilitating the adoption of new ways of working

• Make data-informed prioritization and investment decisions in complex and changing environments

• Communicate effectively across all organizational levels, creating clarity, collaboration, and commitment

• Translate technical concepts into business value and measurable outcomes.

• Have a strong understanding of Agile methodology. The successful candidate will have a solid foundation in Agile product management and modern product operating models.

• Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, for working in teams in Denmark and Poland.

**Be your best self with BEC’s benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, salsa dancing etc.

• Flexible starting time

• Health insurance

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let’s chat and see if we’re a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you’ll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let’s learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contact: We’re ready to welcome and onboard you to BEC!

If you have any questions related to the position, please contact Talent attraction partner- Patrycja Krzykala or Product Manager- Henrik Ellesø: (+45) 61 56 75 68.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

**Copenhagen, Denmark

**R1010024

**2026-10-28

**Hitachi Rail Denmark A/S

**Engineering & Science

**Full time

**About Us

**A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in.

**Job Description:

****Solution Architect

****About The F-Bane Programme

**The F-Bane Programme is a landmark project driven by Banedanmark, focused on upgrading Denmark’s railway network by introducing the European Train Control System (ETCS) Level 2. This modernisation effort is being delivered in the western part of the country by a Joint Venture between Hitachi Rail GTS Denmark and Strukton.

Our goal? Replace outdated analogue signalling systems with cutting-edge digital solutions - improving safety, increasing capacity, and enabling more reliable and punctual train service across Jutland. This is a key step in Denmark’s journey to becoming a global frontrunner in sustainable, intelligent rail transport.

**About The Role & Our Team

**As a Solution Architect, you’ll take a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction and implementation of ETCS L2. You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, system architecture, and project execution - collaborating with internal design teams, Hitachi subsidiaries, suppliers, and partners.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys connecting high-level strategy with practical implementation and thrives in a diverse, international environment where teamwork, structure, and creativity coexist.

**Key Responsibilities

**You’ll play a key role in the delivery of Denmark’s next-generation digital rail network. Responsibilities include:

• Align Engineering requirements on the specific Railway signaling and ETCS Level 2 design

• Align the specific signaling design with the features delivered by the generic system in close collaboration with the generic solution architect

• Coordinating technical activities with all internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure alignment on the signaling and ETCS design.

• Maintain and review and adjust the engineering process for continuous improvement

• Creating and updating Rules and Guidelines that support solution architecture and design.

• Prepare Solutions for Change Requests and contributing to change impact analysis.

• Approving technical deliverables to the project management

• Participating in Defect Management Boards and Change Control Boards, providing technical assessments and solutions.

**Who We’re Looking For

**We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with expertise in ETCS and railway signaling systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with excellent communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for delivering high-impact solutions.

**Qualifications & Experience

**

• 5+ years’ experience in railway signaling and ETCS.

• 5+ years’ experience in railway operations and principles

• Proven experience in a similar role (system design, complex systems architecture, project engineering, validation or operational safety) in the transportation sector or an equivalent field.

• Ability to solve technical problems and analytical thinking, while demonstrating creativity and autonomy in decision-making.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and a passion for collaborative work and technical management. You enjoy coordinating teams, are open-minded, and comfortable presenting to clients.

• Fluent in English; Danish is a plus

**What It’s Like To Work With Us

**

• A flexible hybrid working model (main office in Ballerup)

• A collaborative and international team that values shared knowledge and respect

• A workplace committed to continuous learning and development

• The opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable transport in Denmark

**Workin in Hitachi:

**Our employees are our most important asset and we provide an environment that encourages a healthy work/life balance and we offer a flexible hybrid work environment based on Working from home and office presence (40/60). Your manager will interact with you on a regular basis, ensuring you a career path that suits your needs and ambitions. Beside the traditional benefits like pension, 6 weeks of holidays, canteen etc., we also are proud of offering some good and very professional skilled colleagues.

Thank you for your interest in Hitachi Rail. If your application is of interest, we will be in contact. Please do not hesitate to discover more about us and our latest jobs at https://www.hitachirail.com/careers**.

**At Hitachi Rail, there is a place for everyone. We welcome and value differences in background, age, gender, sexuality, family status, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, religion, and world view. **It is our commitment to create an inclusive environment - we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

****We would be delighted if you would be one of our followers at https://www.linkedin.com/company/hitachirail

Our client is a fast-growing international software company. It is a global leader in its field and is growing by more than 25% every year. The company has the ambition to more than triple in size over the next four to five years. The company is owned by a private equity fund and is anonymous in this advertisement. To lead sales performance and lead generation, we are now looking for a

Head of Growth

High impact – Growth journey – Sales performance

Do you want to be the right hand of the CEO, with overall responsibility for sales performance and lead generation across an international group? And do you want to be a close sparring partner for both the CEO and the private equity owner while the company sets out to more than triple in size?

As Head of Growth you take on a central, high-impact role, where you lead sales teams and inside sales teams together with the country heads. You will own the full lead life cycle: you build and run performance management across the funnel (lead generation, MQLs, SQLs and conversion) and you are also accountable for generating MQLs and SQLs, as the Lead Generation Manager reports directly to you. You measure the effectiveness of marketing, inside sales and sales through pipeline reporting against budget at group, country and individual level.

The role is international and requires a presence within the EU. The location is flexible within Denmark.

Reporting to the Group CEO, your responsibilities will include:

• Own lead generation: lead and develop the Lead Generation Manager and be accountable for the volume and quality of MQLs and SQLs delivered to the sales teams

• Adapt, refine and align the sales funnel and sales process across business units, enabling best-practice sharing and sales problem-solving (knowledge of HubSpot and sales operations is a benefit)

• Drive sales team performance by instilling a culture of accountability, motivation and resilience, and by challenging the teams to achieve more

• Test new sales approaches, refine pitches and explore new methods

• Build a high-performing sales culture and develop the company’s sales playbook, including training, motivation and team development

• Scale sales strategies across multiple European markets and roll out a consistent playbook while allowing for local differences

• Act as a close sparring partner to the CEO and the private equity owner, including performance reporting and follow-up

To succeed in the role, you have 5–15 years of sales experience as both a sales rep and a sales manager, ideally in B2B SaaS or SME-focused sales. You are a high-energy, hands-on, front-line leader who thrives in high-growth environments and who regularly motivates, coaches and develops sales teams to top performance. You are comfortable with modern sales tools and can work across many stakeholders, including a private equity owner. You are fluent in English, and German is an advantage.

You are highly analytical and performance-driven, curious, and thorough when it comes to process and detail. You are known for your energy, your ability to bring people with you and your willingness to stand your ground.

Anonymity, private equity ownership and NDA

The company is anonymous in this advertisement and is owned by a private equity fund. As the role involves close and ongoing interaction with the fund, it is important to us that you know about the ownership structure from the start. We work with an NDA (non-disclosure agreement). The first conversation with Sensu takes place without an NDA. Before you meet the company, you sign an NDA, after which you receive full information about the company, its ownership and the role.

Are you our new Head of Growth? Then please upload your application and CV. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexuality, ethnicity and religion. For further information about the position, please contact Thomas Bech, CEO at Sensu, on +45 22 89 89 76.

Please note that we do not work with application deadlines, as applications are processed on a rolling basis.

**Job Description

**

Global Business Development Manager

Posting Start Date: 10/8/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

**About The Role

**We are excited to offer an incredible opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join Scandinavian Tobacco Group’s growing Next Generation Products team. In this pivotal role, you will be essential in supporting our innovative ventures beyond tobacco, using strategic insights and a strong understanding of global market trends. Moreover, you will be responsible for shaping and managing our global product portfolio while identifying strategic business opportunities to drive global growth. You will work cross-functionally to deliver and execute portfolio strategies & business development opportunities that help grow our brands and company.

Your role as a self-reliant professional is crucial in our fast-paced environment. A key part of your role will involve ensuring clear communication and alignment within the organization, while fostering robust professional relationships. You will be reporting to the Head of Business Development.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

****Lead Category Development

**

• Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for next generation products, ensuring alignment with consumer preferences and market trends.

• Analyzing market trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats for the brand and category portfolio to improve performance & profitability.

• Evaluate the performance of the portfolio and adjust as needed to ensure it continues to deliver growth and profitability.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.
